threads.name: UofT PhD

threads.detail: PhD student, U of Toronto, Cell & Systems Biology: conifer cold tolerance (dehydrin proteins). A+ in Computational Biology & Bioinformatics — a Python project aligning and quantifying SNPs in a microbial genome. Completed the second semester, then left to pivot to data. The pivot wasn't drift.
threads.plain_line: PhD student, Cell & Systems Biology — completed the second semester, A+ in Computational Biology, then left to pivot to data.

trunks.name: The Deliberate Pivot
trunks.trigger: Left a PhD, went back to school for data, then shipped four projects in three months.

threads.name: Lantern Data Cert.
threads.trigger: 91st percentile on DataCamp. Four months that COVID stretched to six.
threads.detail: Data Analytics & Data Science Certificate, Lantern Institute, Toronto — six months, in person. SQL, Tableau, R, Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, keras). Advertised as four months; COVID extended it to six, with classes and the project running concurrently. A structured full-time commitment, not a drift.
threads.plain_line: Data Analytics & Data Science Certificate — six months in person; 91st percentile on DataCamp assessments.

threads.name: Portfolio quarter
threads.trigger: A fintech dashboard, a health viz app, two Kaggles. Three months, unpaid, on purpose.
threads.detail: Self-directed portfolio, no clients: an Interac KPI dashboard (Tableau) · a Samsung Health viz app (Dash/Plotly on GCP App Engine) · Kaggle credit-card fraud (autoencoder + XGBoost, +12%) · Kaggle disaster-tweets NLP (87% accuracy). Breadth-first entry into a new field — and the quarter that confirmed the pivot.
threads.plain_line: Portfolio quarter — four self-directed data projects (Tableau, Dash on GCP, two Kaggle competitions). Unpaid, no clients.

threads.name: BugSeq Taxonomy DB
threads.trigger: SQLite from NCBI FTP to validate a microbial taxonomy ML model. Biology met DE.
threads.detail: Data Scientist Intern, Next Gen Microbiology. NCBI Taxonomy FTP → SQLite. Schema design to validate BugSeq ML model. First explicit DE work — and first time biology knowledge directly accelerated it.
threads.plain_line: Data Scientist Intern — NCBI Taxonomy into SQLite to validate a microbial-taxonomy ML model.

threads.name: Protein ML (Waterloo)
threads.trigger: Bayesian hyperparameter search through combinatorial protein sequence space.
threads.detail: ML Intern, U of Waterloo. Feature extraction from protein databases. Ensemble ML + Bayesian tuning (Hyperopt) + Dask parallelism. QSAR prediction. Research-grade ML fluency, not just applied tooling.
threads.plain_line: Machine Learning Intern — ensemble QSAR model over protein features, Bayesian tuning, Dask. Also a TA.

trunks.name: Production Data Engineering
trunks.trigger: 2.5 years shipping real pipelines and compliance automation at Snowflake itself.

threads.name: Ingestion & Governance
threads.trigger: GitHub GraphQL, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Okta — 20+ APIs, one central intake.
threads.detail: Data Engineer, Snowflake, Pune. Among earliest Pune office employees. ELT via Lambda, API Gateway, External Functions, Fivetran, Airflow. SnowPro Core certified 2023. The real edge sat above the tools: given a vague request, read the app’s API docs, get the admins on a call, and work out which columns are load-bearing, what’s sensitive, who should see it. One central intake, reused across legal, finance, HR, sales and security — not per-dashboard pipelines.
threads.plain_line: Data Engineer — source onboarding and governance for 20+ SaaS systems into one central intake; among the Pune office's first hires.

threads.name: SOX Automation
threads.trigger: SQL that replaced 100+ manual audit hours per quarter. Audit became a partner team.
threads.detail: Real-time SQL monitoring: Access Management exceptions, SSO/SCIM gaps, Password Control violations. 100+ audit hours saved per quarter. Changed business processes. Not just pipelines — systems that change behaviour.
threads.plain_line: Data Engineer — real-time SOX-compliance monitoring built with Internal Audit; 100+ manual audit hours saved a quarter.

threads.name: 7 Audiences + IIA

threads.detail: 7 external customer presentations. IIA San Jose chapter. Represented Snowflake at US industry events. A Data Engineer who presents to external auditors is unusual. Connects directly to Banff 2014.
threads.plain_line: Speaker — seven external customer presentations on the SOX work, including the IIA San Jose chapter.

trunks.name: Genomics–Cloud Bridge

threads.name: Algorithmic Biologics
threads.trigger: Gene expression app to AWS. Batch → GKE. Biology + cloud + production. All three at once.
threads.detail: Cloud Engineer, Algorithmic Biologics, Bengaluru. Deployed Tapestry gene expression app to AWS. AWS Batch → GKE migration. Collaborated with bioinformaticians on variant calling. For bio roles: this is already the work.
threads.plain_line: Cloud Engineer — a genomics startup: gene-expression app to AWS, Batch → GKE, EBS → S3 (~50% storage cost cut).

trunks.name: AI Tools Era
trunks.trigger: Built independently. Got clear on what I want.

threads.name: Noëtone — Kanz GOLD
threads.trigger: Rated GOLD from 3,500 submissions. 388 pages survived three power cuts.
threads.detail: Independent build. A document-to-audio pipeline (Flask + SQLite): PDFs, scans and handwriting become audio files you own. Rated GOLD in the 2026 Kanz “Build with AI” Portfolio, from 3,500 submissions, judged on originality, technical depth, impact and presentation (KANZ-ADV-1601). Free-tier limits and power cuts became the design, not the obstacle: per-page commits so jobs resume, error classification, a quota-aware circuit breaker. Instructable OCR — the prompt is a config parameter, so a figure gets described rather than read as broken axis labels.
threads.plain_line: Independent build — a document-to-audio pipeline on a free API tier; GOLD in the 2026 Kanz Build-with-AI portfolio, from 3,500.

threads.name: AI App Portfolio
threads.trigger: Friction-killers built in a chat window. No pipeline, no team. Each one from a real annoyance.
threads.detail: mindful-spend (Gemini Vision receipts to a ledger), Skill Refresh (interview prep that keeps score, live on Render), Kobo Sky (a night-sky dashboard for an e-reader on a wall), a task dashboard, a mutual-fund screener, a handwriting-to-text tool. Each from a real friction point. 'The syntax got cheap. The judgment didn't.' Noëtone grew out of this pile into its own node.
threads.plain_line: Independent builds — a portfolio of small AI tools, each from a real friction point (mindful-spend, Skill Refresh, Kobo Sky).

claims.evidence_text: Noëtone turned a 388-page scanned book into audio through three power cuts without losing a page, on a free API tier of three calls a minute. Before that: 20+ ingestion sources at Snowflake, and SOX-compliance monitoring that replaced 100+ manual audit hours a quarter.

Founded catadoption_pune in 2024. Around 120 street cats rehomed, a public site and adoption board built and live, near-daily posting sustained for two years. Taught a general-purpose AI the realities of grassroots Indian animal welfare — and kept a human deciding.

Snowflake in Pune, a genomics startup in Bengaluru, a machine-learning internship at Waterloo, research at UBC and UofT, a biotech startup in Vancouver. Two countries, industry and academia, wet lab to warehouse.
Claude Code, Gemini API, OpenRouter, DuckDB, Flask, GitHub Actions — on top of the proven set: Snowflake, AWS Lambda and API Gateway, SQL, Python, Airflow, Fivetran.

A document system that keeps a dozen parallel AI sessions consistent across folders; a shelf map with a script that checks every document's tags against it; reusable procedure files the model executes.
